title: Forward Comparison Configuration
statement: Given a positive number $k$ of work tapes, two designated work tapes, a configuration in the run, rewind, or done phase, and a natural number $r$, the resulting configuration has state run, and the head positions on the two designated tapes are each increased by $r$; all other head positions and configuration fields are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes
A configuration in one of the three flag phases
